source_text: Well, I’ll be damned… At least you have good taste in art. I have one just like it at home.

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.Well, I’ll be damned… At least you have good taste in art. I have one just like it at home.
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.Well, I’ll be damned… At least you have good taste in art. I have one just like it at home."

translation: No nie, niech mnie… Przynajmniej masz dobry gust artystyczny. Mam w domu taki sam.

source_text: Heh… Somehow I doubt yours is ‘’just like it’’.

structure.raw_value: JdAnOp^.Heh… Somehow I doubt yours is ‘’just like it’’.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnOp^.Heh… Somehow I doubt yours is ‘’just like it’’."

translation: Heh… Jakoś wątpię, by twój był „taki sam”.

source_text: Ahem, let’s get to the point.

structure.raw_value: JdAnOp^.Ahem, let’s get to the point.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnOp^.Ahem, let’s get to the point."

translation: Ech, przejdźmy do sedna.

source_text: What’s this about some dingy farm?

structure.raw_value: JdAnDe^.What’s this about some dingy farm?
structure.script_literal: "JdAnDe^.What’s this about some dingy farm?"

translation: Co to za sprawa z jakąś obskurną farmą?

source_text: Dingy? I’ll have you know it’s a beautiful farm!

structure.raw_value: CaAnOp.Dingy? I’ll have you know it’s a beautiful farm!
structure.script_literal: "CaAnOp.Dingy? I’ll have you know it’s a beautiful farm!"

translation: Obskurną? To piękna farma!

source_text: ‘’Your Honor’’.

structure.raw_value: JdAnDe^.‘’Your Honor’’.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnDe^.‘’Your Honor’’."

translation: „Wysoki Sądzie”.

source_text: … Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.… Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.… Your Honor."

translation: …Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: I got this notice from the court that my farm is being taken over by the state.

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx.I got this notice from the court that my farm is being taken over by the state.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx.I got this notice from the court that my farm is being taken over by the state."

translation: Dostałam zawiadomienie z sądu, że moja farma jest przejmowana przez stan.

source_text: Ah yes, this matter.

structure.raw_value: JdBaOp^.Ah yes, this matter.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaOp^.Ah yes, this matter."

translation: Ach, tak, ta sprawa.

source_text: Unfortunately, there’s nothing that can be done about this.

structure.raw_value: JdBaDe^.Unfortunately, there’s nothing that can be done about this.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaDe^.Unfortunately, there’s nothing that can be done about this."

translation: Niestety, nic nie da się z tym zrobić.

source_text: The state has a responsibility to preserve ancient Casula culture, and your farm happens to be right on top of it.

structure.raw_value: JdBaEx^.The state has a responsibility to preserve ancient Casula culture, and your farm happens to be right on top of it.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaEx^.The state has a responsibility to preserve ancient Casula culture, and your farm happens to be right on top of it."

translation: Stan ma obowiązek zachować starożytną kulturę Casula, a twoja farma leży akurat na niej.

source_text: This is ridiculous! You can’t take my home from me! I have a beautiful house and I’m not giving that up!

structure.raw_value: CaMaDe.This is ridiculous! You can’t take my home from me! I have a beautiful house and I’m not giving that up!
structure.script_literal: "CaMaDe.This is ridiculous! You can’t take my home from me! I have a beautiful house and I’m not giving that up!"

translation: To śmieszne! Nie możecie zabrać mi domu! Mam piękny dom i nie zamierzam go oddać!

source_text: Beautiful? I somehow doubt that… Now a mansion overlooking the river… that will be beautiful.

structure.raw_value: JdFrOp^.Beautiful? I somehow doubt that… Now a mansion overlooking the river… that will be beautiful.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrOp^.Beautiful? I somehow doubt that… Now a mansion overlooking the river… that will be beautiful."

translation: Piękny? Jakoś wątpię… Za to rezydencja z widokiem na rzekę… ta będzie piękna.

source_text: Mansion?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Mansion?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Mansion?"

translation: Rezydencja?

source_text: Uh, did I say mansion?

structure.raw_value: JdWoCl^.Uh, did I say mansion?
structure.script_literal: "JdWoCl^.Uh, did I say mansion?"

translation: Yh, czy powiedziałem rezydencja?

source_text: Are you going to build a mansion on my land!?

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.Are you going to build a mansion on my land!?
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.Are you going to build a mansion on my land!?"

translation: Zamierzasz zbudować rezydencję na mojej ziemi!?

source_text: You must have misheard me. I meant government housing.

structure.raw_value: JdFrEx^.You must have misheard me. I meant government housing.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrEx^.You must have misheard me. I meant government housing."

translation: Musiałaś mnie źle usłyszeć. Miałem na myśli budownictwo komunalne.

source_text: You know, there are much more scenic places in North Santiva for the state to build government housing on.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You know, there are much more scenic places in North Santiva for the state to build government housing on.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You know, there are much more scenic places in North Santiva for the state to build government housing on."

translation: Wiesz, są znacznie bardziej malownicze miejsca w North Santiva, gdzie stan mógłby budować budownictwo komunalne.

source_text: Are there? Not that I’m interested, but go on.

structure.raw_value: JdBaDe^.Are there? Not that I’m interested, but go on.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaDe^.Are there? Not that I’m interested, but go on."

translation: Są? Nie że jestem zainteresowany, ale mów dalej.

source_text: The Casula Forest has a lot of nice, undeveloped areas.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.The Casula Forest has a lot of nice, undeveloped areas.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.The Casula Forest has a lot of nice, undeveloped areas."

translation: Las Casula ma sporo ładnych, niezabudowanych terenów.

source_text: In my experience, there’s a lot of Casula culture to be found there, too.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.In my experience, there’s a lot of Casula culture to be found there, too.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.In my experience, there’s a lot of Casula culture to be found there, too."

translation: Z mojego doświadczenia, można tam też znaleźć sporo kultury Casula.

source_text: No doubt the state could claim some of that land for preservation.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.No doubt the state could claim some of that land for preservation.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.No doubt the state could claim some of that land for preservation."

translation: Bez wątpienia stan mógłby przejąć część tej ziemi pod ochronę.

source_text: Land that would require a nice mansion to oversee the preservation of the area.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Land that would require a nice mansion to oversee the preservation of the area.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Land that would require a nice mansion to oversee the preservation of the area."

translation: Ziemię, która wymagałaby ładnej rezydencji do nadzorowania ochrony terenu.

source_text: I mean, government housing.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I mean, government housing.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I mean, government housing."

translation: To znaczy, budownictwa komunalnego.

source_text: Hmm, interesting.

structure.raw_value: JdBaDe^.Hmm, interesting.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaDe^.Hmm, interesting."

translation: Hmm, ciekawe.

source_text: What the hell.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDeNo1.What the hell.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDeNo1.What the hell."

translation: A niech to.

source_text: Are you certain, detective? I think the court is going to need evidence to prove your case.

structure.raw_value: JdBaEx^.Are you certain, detective? I think the court is going to need evidence to prove your case.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaEx^.Are you certain, detective? I think the court is going to need evidence to prove your case."

translation: Jesteś pewien, detektywie? Myślę, że sąd będzie potrzebował dowodów na poparcie twojej sprawy.

source_text: Absolutely. I’ll head over right now and come back with photos of a suitable area.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Absolutely. I’ll head over right now and come back with photos of a suitable area.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Absolutely. I’ll head over right now and come back with photos of a suitable area."

translation: Absolutnie. Skoczę tam zaraz i wrócę ze zdjęciami odpowiedniego terenu.

source_text: Okay, detective. I’ll withhold judgment until you return. But you had better be quick about it.

structure.raw_value: JdBaDe^.Okay, detective. I’ll withhold judgment until you return. But you had better be quick about it.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaDe^.Okay, detective. I’ll withhold judgment until you return. But you had better be quick about it."

translation: Dobrze, detektywie. Wstrzymam się z wyrokiem, aż wrócisz. Ale lepiej się pospiesz.

source_text: Miss Ray, you can return home. I’ll let you know the result…

structure.raw_value: JdBaEx^.Miss Ray, you can return home. I’ll let you know the result…
structure.script_literal: "JdBaEx^.Miss Ray, you can return home. I’ll let you know the result…"

translation: Panno Ray, możesz wracać do domu. Dam znać o wyniku…

source_text: I’m not going anywhere until this is done.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.I’m not going anywhere until this is done.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.I’m not going anywhere until this is done."

translation: Nigdzie się nie ruszę, dopóki to się nie skończy.

source_text: God damn it… Hurry this up, detective.

structure.raw_value: JdAnOp^.God damn it… Hurry this up, detective.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnOp^.God damn it… Hurry this up, detective."

translation: Cholera… Pospiesz się, detektywie.

source_text: Don’t worry, Carol. I’ve got this.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Don’t worry, Carol. I’ve got this.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Don’t worry, Carol. I’ve got this."

translation: Nie martw się, Carol. Ogarnę to.

source_text: You had better, 1Hero. I can’t imagine losing my farm to this doofus.

structure.raw_value: CaWoDe.You had better, 1Hero. I can’t imagine losing my farm to this doofus.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoDe.You had better, 1Hero. I can’t imagine losing my farm to this doofus."

translation: Lepiej, 1Hero. Nie wyobrażam sobie stracić farmy przez tego idiotę.

source_text: So what’s this about, Your Honor?

structure.raw_value: BoWoOp.So what’s this about, Your Honor?
structure.script_literal: "BoWoOp.So what’s this about, Your Honor?"

translation: O co chodzi, Wysoki Sądzie?

source_text: A robbery! Right here under your nose, no less!

structure.raw_value: JdMaAg^.A robbery! Right here under your nose, no less!
structure.script_literal: "JdMaAg^.A robbery! Right here under your nose, no less!"

translation: Kradzież! Tuż pod twoim nosem, na dodatek!

source_text: Someone stole something from you?

structure.raw_value: BoBaOp.Someone stole something from you?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaOp.Someone stole something from you?"

translation: Ktoś coś ci ukradł?

source_text: What did they take?

structure.raw_value: BoBaOp.What did they take?
structure.script_literal: "BoBaOp.What did they take?"

translation: Co zabrali?

source_text: Well… uh…

structure.raw_value: JdAnOp^.Well… uh…
structure.script_literal: "JdAnOp^.Well… uh…"

translation: Cóż… yyy…

source_text: Yes, Your Honor, what did they take?

structure.raw_value: McFlDeNo4.Yes, Your Honor, what did they take?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDeNo4.Yes, Your Honor, what did they take?"

translation: Tak, Wysoki Sądzie, co zabrali?

source_text: My pen!

structure.raw_value: JdAnEx^.My pen!
structure.script_literal: "JdAnEx^.My pen!"

translation: Mój długopis!

source_text: Your pen?

structure.raw_value: BoShOp.Your pen?
structure.script_literal: "BoShOp.Your pen?"

translation: Twój długopis?

source_text: Hahaha.

structure.raw_value: McFrOpNo3.Hahaha.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOpNo3.Hahaha."

translation: Hahaha.

source_text: Of course I am! It was very, very important to me.

structure.raw_value: JdAnAg^.Of course I am! It was very, very important to me.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnAg^.Of course I am! It was very, very important to me."

translation: Oczywiście, że tak! Był dla mnie bardzo, bardzo ważny.

source_text: You have to get it back right away.

structure.raw_value: JdAnEx^.You have to get it back right away.
structure.script_literal: "JdAnEx^.You have to get it back right away."

translation: Musisz go odzyskać natychmiast.

source_text: Uh huh. How ‘bout you file a report on that, and we’ll get right on it.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.Uh huh. How ‘bout you file a report on that, and we’ll get right on it.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.Uh huh. How ‘bout you file a report on that, and we’ll get right on it."

translation: Mhm. Może złóż na to raport, a my się tym od razu zajmiemy.

source_text: A report?

structure.raw_value: JdWoCl^.A report?
structure.script_literal: "JdWoCl^.A report?"

translation: Raport?

source_text: Good day, Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: BoAnOp.Good day, Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnOp.Good day, Your Honor."

translation: Miłego dnia, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: You! It was you, wasn’t it?

structure.raw_value: JdMaAg.You! It was you, wasn’t it?
structure.script_literal: "JdMaAg.You! It was you, wasn’t it?"

translation: Ty! To ty, prawda?

source_text: Me? I was busy talking with Bobby. Do you see me holding your… missing pen?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Me? I was busy talking with Bobby. Do you see me holding your… missing pen?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Me? I was busy talking with Bobby. Do you see me holding your… missing pen?"

translation: Ja? Byłem zajęty rozmową z Bobbym. Widzisz u mnie twój… zagubiony długopis?

source_text: You know damn well what was taken.

structure.raw_value: JdMaDe.You know damn well what was taken.
structure.script_literal: "JdMaDe.You know damn well what was taken."

translation: Dobrze wiesz, co zostało zabrane.

source_text: If you’re so upset about it, why not file a report for it?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.If you’re so upset about it, why not file a report for it?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.If you’re so upset about it, why not file a report for it?"

translation: Jeśli tak ci zależy, czemu nie zgłosisz kradzieży?

source_text: Or maybe reporting the theft of a painting – one already reported to be stolen – could be a problem?

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Or maybe reporting the theft of a painting – one already reported to be stolen – could be a problem?
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Or maybe reporting the theft of a painting – one already reported to be stolen – could be a problem?"

translation: A może zgłoszenie kradzieży obrazu — który już został zgłoszony jako skradziony — byłoby problemem?

source_text: Good day, Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Good day, Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Good day, Your Honor."

translation: Miłego dnia, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: You owe your promotion to me, detective… Don’t forget that.

structure.raw_value: JdBaOp.You owe your promotion to me, detective… Don’t forget that.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaOp.You owe your promotion to me, detective… Don’t forget that."

translation: Swój awans zawdzięczasz mnie, detektywie… Nie zapominaj o tym.

source_text: And you owe your future Koi pond to Kimura… Don’t you forget that.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.And you owe your future Koi pond to Kimura… Don’t you forget that.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.And you owe your future Koi pond to Kimura… Don’t you forget that."

translation: A ty swój przyszły stawik koi zawdzięczasz Kimurze… Nie zapominaj o tym.

source_text: It’ll be a kick-ass mansion, Canmore.

structure.raw_value: JdFrOp.It’ll be a kick-ass mansion, Canmore.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrOp.It’ll be a kick-ass mansion, Canmore."

translation: To będzie zajebista rezydencja, Canmore.

source_text: I’m sure it will be.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I’m sure it will be.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I’m sure it will be."

translation: Jestem pewien, że będzie.

source_text: We have a buyer.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.We have a buyer.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.We have a buyer."

translation: Mamy kupca.

source_text: 1Hero? So you want to buy Andrea's old mansion, huh?

structure.raw_value: JdBaDe.1Hero? So you want to buy Andrea's old mansion, huh?
structure.script_literal: "JdBaDe.1Hero? So you want to buy Andrea's old mansion, huh?"

translation: 1Hero? Więc chcesz kupić starą rezydencję Andrei, huh?

source_text: It’s a great place. The jacuzzi alone is amazing.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s a great place. The jacuzzi alone is amazing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s a great place. The jacuzzi alone is amazing."

translation: Świetne miejsce. Samo jacuzzi jest niesamowite.

source_text: A koi pond might be better.

structure.raw_value: JdFrEx.A koi pond might be better.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrEx.A koi pond might be better."

translation: Stawik koi mógłby być lepszy.

source_text: I think I’ll stick with the jacuzzi.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.I think I’ll stick with the jacuzzi.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.I think I’ll stick with the jacuzzi."

translation: Chyba zostanę przy jacuzzi.

source_text: Fair enough. Look, I like you, detective. So how about the state cuts you a little slack?

structure.raw_value: JdFrOp.Fair enough. Look, I like you, detective. So how about the state cuts you a little slack?
structure.script_literal: "JdFrOp.Fair enough. Look, I like you, detective. So how about the state cuts you a little slack?"

translation: Fair enough. Słuchaj, lubię cię, detektywie. Więc może stan przymknie oko?

source_text: No property taxes?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.No property taxes?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.No property taxes?"

translation: Bez podatku od nieruchomości?

source_text: Hahaha, that’s a good one. No, of course you’ll have to pay property taxes.

structure.raw_value: JdHaOp.Hahaha, that’s a good one. No, of course you’ll have to pay property taxes.
structure.script_literal: "JdHaOp.Hahaha, that’s a good one. No, of course you’ll have to pay property taxes."

translation: Hahaha, niezły. Nie, oczywiście będziesz musiał płacić podatek od nieruchomości.

source_text: But on the bright side, we’ll give you a special discount on the mansion sale.

structure.raw_value: JdFrEx.But on the bright side, we’ll give you a special discount on the mansion sale.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrEx.But on the bright side, we’ll give you a special discount on the mansion sale."

translation: Ale z dobrej strony, damy ci specjalną zniżkę na sprzedaż rezydencji.

source_text: The least we could do for our famous public servant.

structure.raw_value: JdFrEx.The least we could do for our famous public servant.
structure.script_literal: "JdFrEx.The least we could do for our famous public servant."

translation: Tyle możemy zrobić dla naszego słynnego funkcjonariusza.

source_text: Miss Wilson, let’s make that happen.

structure.raw_value: JdBaEx.Miss Wilson, let’s make that happen.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaEx.Miss Wilson, let’s make that happen."

translation: Panno Wilson, zróbmy to.

source_text: You’ve got it, Your Honor.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp^.You’ve got it, Your Honor.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp^.You’ve got it, Your Honor."

translation: Zrozumiano, Wysoki Sądzie.

source_text: If that’s all, I need to get going.

structure.raw_value: JdBaOp.If that’s all, I need to get going.
structure.script_literal: "JdBaOp.If that’s all, I need to get going."

translation: Jeśli to wszystko, muszę iść.

source_text: I made the mistake of eating those tacos again…

structure.raw_value: JdWoOp.I made the mistake of eating those tacos again…
structure.script_literal: "JdWoOp.I made the mistake of eating those tacos again…"

translation: Znowu zjadłem te tacos…

source_text: The mansion is yours!

structure.raw_value: HeFrAg.The mansion is yours!
structure.script_literal: "HeFrAg.The mansion is yours!"

translation: Rezydencja jest twoja!

source_text: The mansion is mine!

structure.raw_value: McFrAg.The mansion is mine!
structure.script_literal: "McFrAg.The mansion is mine!"

translation: Rezydencja jest moja!

source_text: I’m so proud of you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: HeFrDe.I’m so proud of you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrDe.I’m so proud of you, 1Hero."

translation: Jestem z ciebie taka dumna, 1Hero.

source_text: I can hardly believe I pulled this off… It took so much work.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I can hardly believe I pulled this off… It took so much work.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I can hardly believe I pulled this off… It took so much work."

translation: Ledwo mogę uwierzyć, że mi się udało… Tyle pracy.

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. This calls for a celebratory drink.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.Come on, 1Hero. This calls for a celebratory drink.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.Come on, 1Hero. This calls for a celebratory drink."

translation: Chodź, 1Hero. Należy ci się drink z okazji świętowania.
